- Livestock Insurance (@6% on animal cost): ₹10,200

- Green Fodder (first batch): ₹4,320
- Dry Fodder (first batch): ₹1,080

chunks.source_title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) Scheme Guidelines
chunks.source_organization: Ministry of MSME, Government of India
chunks.text:
PMEGP Revised Guidelines 2022-23: Financial Parameters and Margin Money Subsidy Rates (Pages 4-5):
1. Maximum Project Cost Eligible for Subsidy:
   - Manufacturing Sector: ₹50,00,000 (Fifty Lakh Rupees)
   - Business / Service Sector: ₹20,00,000 (Twenty Lakh Rupees)
2. Margin Money Capital Subsidy Matrix (Para 3.2 Table):
   - Rural Special Category (SC/ST/OBC/Women/Minorities/Ex-servicemen/PH): 35% of project cost (Beneficiary equity: 5%)
   - Rural General Category: 25% of project cost (Beneficiary equity: 10%)
   - Urban Special Category: 25% of project cost (Beneficiary equity: 5%)
   - Urban General Category: 15% of project cost (Beneficiary equity: 10%)
3. Financing Structure: Bank advances balance project outlay (60% to 75%) as composite loan. Subsidy is kept in Subsidy Reserve Fund for 3 years lock-in.

chunks.source_title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) Scheme Guidelines
chunks.source_organization: Ministry of MSME, Government of India
chunks.text:
PMEGP Eligibility and Lending Norms (Source: Ministry of MSME, Pages 5-10):
1. Applicant Eligibility (Para 4.1):
   - Minimum Age: 18 years.
   - Minimum Education: At least VIII Standard pass for projects costing above ₹10 Lakhs in Manufacturing and above ₹5 Lakhs in Service.
   - Family Limit: Only one person from one family is eligible for financial assistance under PMEGP.
   - Mandatory Registration: Udyam Registration on the Udyam portal is mandatory for PMEGP units.
2. Repayment Schedule & Interest (Para 8):
   - Repayment schedule ranges between 3 to 7 years after initial bank moratorium.
   - Interest rate: Normal banking rate of interest applies on the bank loan portion.

chunks.source_title: NSS Report No. 588: All India Debt & Investment Survey - 2019
chunks.text:
AIDIS NSS 77th Round (Report No. 588): Karnataka Rural Household Indebtedness Survey Evidence.
1. Incidence of Indebtedness (IOI) in Rural Karnataka (Statement 7, Page 92):
   - All Rural Households: 48.1% of households are indebted.
   - Cultivator Households: 59.2% are indebted.
   - Non-Cultivator Rural Households: 32.9% are indebted.
2. Share of Institutional vs. Non-Institutional Debt (Statement 8, Page 94):
   - Institutional Agencies (Commercial Banks, RRBs, Co-operatives): 67.2% of total outstanding cash debt.
   - Non-Institutional Agencies (Moneylenders, Landlords, Traders, Relatives): 32.5% of total outstanding debt.
Survey Scope: Macro-statistical evidence across rural India and Karnataka. Not applicable to individual loan computations.

chunks.source_title: NSS Report No. 588: All India Debt & Investment Survey - 2019
chunks.text:
AIDIS NSS 77th Round (Report No. 588): Interest Rate Structure of Non-Institutional Debt in Rural Karnataka (Page 97, Statement 10):
Informal Debt Interest Rate Distribution:
- Interest Rate Nil (Friends/Relatives): 24.4% of non-institutional debt
- Interest Rate 20% to 25% p.a.: 36.3% of non-institutional debt
- Interest Rate 30% to 50% p.a.: 18.9% of non-institutional debt
- Interest Rate 50% to 100% p.a.: 2.8% of non-institutional debt
Over 58% of non-institutional rural credit in Karnataka bears interest above 20% p.a., demonstrating the severe cost penalty faced by rural entrepreneurs who lack formal bank documentation.

chunks.source_title: All India Debt and Investment Survey (NSS 77th Round, 2019)
chunks.text:
AIDIS NSS 77th Round (Report No. 588) All-India Rural Debt & Indebtedness Macro Statistics:
1. National Incidence of Indebtedness (IOI, Page 92, Statement 7):
   - All Rural Households: 35.0% report outstanding debt (Karnataka is higher at 48.1%).
   - Rural Cultivator Households: 40.3%.
   - Rural Non-Cultivator Households: 28.2%.
2. National Outstanding Debt Distribution by Agency (Page 94, Statement 8):
   - Institutional Agencies (Banks, Cooperatives): 66.1%.
   - Non-Institutional / Informal Sources (Moneylenders, Relatives): 33.8%.
3. Average Amount of Debt (AOD) & Debt-Asset Ratio (Highlights, Pages 16 & 18):
   - Average Debt per rural household (AOD): ₹59,748 (vs ₹1,20,336 for urban households).
   - Rural Debt-Asset Ratio (DAR): 3.8% (demonstrating solid asset backing across rural households).
Analytical Governance Note: These are observed population-level survey statistics, NOT individual-level underwriting predictions.

chunks.source_title: Master Directions - Reserve Bank of India (Priority Sector Lending - Targets and Classification) 2025
chunks.text:
RBI Priority Sector Lending (PSL) Master Directions 2025 (FIDD):
1. PSL Targets for Scheduled Commercial Banks:
   - Total Priority Sector Target: 40% of Adjusted Net Bank Credit (ANBC).
   - Agriculture Target: 18% of ANBC (with 10% sub-target for Small & Marginal Farmers).
   - Micro-Enterprises Target: 7.5% of ANBC.
2. Allied Agricultural Activities (Chapter III, Section 6.2):
   - Loans for dairy farming, poultry, piggery, bee-keeping, and sheep/goat rearing qualify under Agriculture PSL without sub-ceiling.
3. Khadi and Village Industries (KVI) sector advances qualify for the sub-target of 7.5% prescribed for Micro-enterprises.

chunks.source_title: Broad Eligibility Criteria for Partner Institutions
chunks.source_organization: Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency Limited (MUDRA)
chunks.text:
MUDRA Partner Lending Institution Eligibility Criteria (Refinance Scheme):
STATUS: NEEDS_SOURCE_VERIFICATION (Applies to Partner Lending Institutions, NOT end-borrower rules).
- MUDRA provides refinance support to Commercial Banks, RRBs, Small Finance Banks, and NBFCs for micro unit loans up to ₹20 Lakhs.
- Maximum Refinance Tenure: 36 months (3 years) as per Page 4, Para 3.2.
- Eligible Sectors: Manufacturing, Trading, and Services.
Notice: End-borrower product tiers (Shishu up to ₹50k, Kishore up to ₹5L, Tarun up to ₹10L/₹20L) and interest caps are NOT detailed in this partner institutional document. Formal DFS/Ministry circular is pending ingestion.
